result.title: Use ChatGPT Work to ground analysis in your semantic layer
result.description:
Your data agent needs to understand how your business defines its metrics.

In this clip, OpenAI’s data team explains how a semantic layer brings together key entities, metric definitions, filters, and known pitfalls. See why expert review matters, how existing semantic work can be reused, and why this foundation needs ongoing investment.

Watch the full webinar: https://goldcast.registration.public-pr50.goldcast.io/on-demand/b6b0dd09-425d-42a0-ae02-a9ea4f6ebbcd

Learn more: https://openai.com/business/solutions/data/

result.title: Use ChatGPT Work to build dashboards from a business question
result.description:
Start with the question your team needs to answer: how is product adoption changing?

This ChatGPT Work demo shows a prompt for an adoption dashboard and the prepared result: an interactive funnel, customer segment views, and controls for recurring data refreshes. It uses synthetic data and is edited to show the workflow, not elapsed generation time.

result.title: Use ChatGPT Work to tailor dashboards for every stakeholder
result.description:
Give stakeholders a view of the business that fits the decisions they need to make.

Watch this ChatGPT Work demo adapt dashboard labels and chart types, explore KPIs, and drill into compute demand. Using synthetic data, it shows ways to tailor dashboards and explore the details behind business performance.

result.title: Use ChatGPT Work to turn product insights into a team action plan
result.description:
A drop-off in your adoption funnel tells you where to look. Customer feedback helps you investigate why.

See how usage data and feedback from Slack and Google Drive inform recommendations, then watch ChatGPT Work draft a Slack update for review before posting. This demo uses synthetic data to show the path from a leadership question to proposed team actions.
